summary: No errors identified in the four estimates against the saved 20-page arXiv:2604.22503v2 dated 29 Jun 2026. Read the entire 390-line markdown conversion, including methods and all references; the saved PDF has no appended supplement or embedded attachment. Checked the extraction specification and codebook, extracted every cited source page with PyMuPDF, and inspected Figures 2 and 4 in the PDF. PDF p. 8 explicitly reports -26.9% and p<.001 for clarity under Reranking versus No Intervention. This is a relative change in AI-induced distortion, correctly retained as paper_effect.type=other rather than a rating-point difference or standardized effect. The informativeness, relevance and formality contrasts are identifiable in Figure 4D, but their numerical results and outcome-specific significance marks are figure-only; leaving their statistical fields null follows extraction Rule 1. Page 8 contains no recoverable table. The 769 Study 3 writer completers are printed on p. 11. Outcome-specific writer counts and final rating counts are not printed, so the estimate counts appropriately remain null. Random order of the three AI configurations is explicit on p. 13. Pages 12-14 support immediate AI-assisted outputs, with_ai, ai_design, paired within-person comparisons, human_raters, unit=rating and se_basis=rating: the perception models include reader random effects, without writer random effects. Clarity, informativeness and relevance are output-quality attributes coded usefulness with higher_is=more_creative; formality is a style attribute appropriately coded other with higher_is=other. The saved paper supplies no additional identifiable eligible outcome-specific contrast omitted from the extraction. AI-versus-unaided writing was not randomized; Study 2 lacks scored output outcomes; Studies 4-5 randomize readers of existing texts rather than AI assistance to writers. Completeness beyond the saved paper remains limited by the unavailable separate supplementary information, particularly SI:5.7-5.8 and SI:8.4. No matching local supplement was found. Fresh Python urllib requests using User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named GitHub tree API, raw repository README and OSF registration API all failed with WinError 10013. No supplementary values or missing contrasts were inferred.
